description:
The better you feel - the less you NEED

The less you need - the more ATTRACTIVE YOU ARE

Everything comes easily to those who already FEEL GOOD

And the path towards JOY for NO REASON

Is PRESENCE

Meditate. 

Free yourself from the tension that blocking your GOD GIVEN ENERGY.
transcript: You got to start to understand the better you feel day to day, moment to moment, the more that you feel good for no reason at all, the less that you need, the less desperate that you are and the more attractive that you are. So the easier everything comes to you, especially talking about dating and socializing, when you feel fulfilled, when you don't need anything from anybody, that's when everything comes easy. So you need to recognize if you're approaching your social life and your dating life from a place of desperation, you're making it harder than it needs to be. You need to get in tune with yourself. You need to feel better about about you and your life you need to be able to get into the present moment and recognize this is a beautiful experience I love being alive I love being me and then have that energy flowing through your system and then stabilize that and approach people from there start conversations from there go on dates from there and watch how much easier everything is
